meta.title: Line-Item Level PO–Invoice Matching: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and attempt Line-Item Level PO–Invoice Matching.
Repeat the action as an AP Executive and verify that the feature is available.
Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan and that both persona checks use the same tenant.
